title: Confession of Christ
definition: Confession of Christ is the open acknowledgment that Jesus is Lord and Savior from a heart of faith.
summary: Confession of Christ is the open acknowledgement of Jesus as Lord flowing from genuine faith.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the risen Lord whom believers confess before the world.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Confession is faith made visible through words of allegiance to Jesus Christ. It does not save as a work added to faith, but true faith is not ashamed to identify with the crucified and risen Lord. This doctrine connects the heart's trust with the mouth's witness and the life’s public loyalty.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because hidden or silent Christianity can become shaped by fear of man. Confession reminds believers that Jesus is worthy to be named before family, friends, enemies, and the world. It also clarifies that Christian identity is not private spirituality but allegiance to the Lord.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Speak of Christ with reverence, clarity, and courage. Refuse shame when obedience identifies you with Him. Let baptism, testimony, worship, and daily conversation honestly confess that Jesus is Lord.
